remarks: Whether you're ready to become a homeowner or expand your investment portfolio, this beautifully updated property offers flexibility, convenience, and exciting potential. Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in a convenient location! This stylish 2-bedroom, 1-bath upper unit offers modern finishes, low-maintenance living, and an unbeatable location. The bright, open interior features luxury vinyl flooring, fresh designer paint, quartz countertops, an updated kitchen with a brand-new dishwasher, and a beautifully refreshed bath. The HOA covers heat, gas, and water, helping keep monthly expenses predictable. The shared basement with the lower unit includes a dedicated 10' x 10' private storage area, plus your own washer and dryer for your convenience. Ideally situated near Harlem Rd. and Kensington Ave., you'll enjoy quick access to shopping, dining, I-90, I-290, NY-33, and bus route making commuting a breeze. This turnkey home is an exceptional value. Don't miss your opportunity to own for less than the cost of renting!
